English, 中文, 日本語 are all welcome.

### Page / 页面 / ページ
URL and language:

### Reproduce / 复现步骤 / 再現手順
Include parameter values and playback state when relevant.

### Expected and actual / 预期与实际 / 期待する結果と実際の結果
What happened, and what should happen instead? For a scientific correction, include a reference or calculation if possible.

### Environment / 环境 / 環境
Browser, device, and screenshot (optional). Please remove private information.
